Team —

Quick heads up: the Q1 submission window opens at noon PT today and closes EOD Monday. I need every rep to update the lane/status fields in the forecast sheet and add a 1‑line note on confidence (High/Med/Low) for any deals marked commit or best case. Key asks: 

- Update "Expected Close" and "Stage" for all active opportunities in HubSpot by 12:00 PT.
- Upload the completed row(s) into the shared template in Drive (link below) so RevOps can ingest.
- If you have any late-stage blockers (legal, SSO, procurement), flag them here and on the 15m handoff.

I booked a short 15‑minute handoff at 3:30pm PT for quick triage — agenda is purely callouts on outliers and final lane swaps. If you can't make it, drop notes in the sheet and @Marissa so she can speak for your lane.

Attachments: 2027_Q1_forecast_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/forecast-Q1-2027
HubSpot: 12345

Thanks — keep it tight, we only need correct gates, not prose.
